statusLine.command: input=$(cat); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name'); used=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // empty'); five=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.rate_limits.five_hour.used_percentage // empty'); week=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.rate_limits.seven_day.used_percentage // empty'); out="$model"; [ -n "$used" ] && out="$out | ctx:$(printf '%.0f' "$used")%"; [ -n "$five" ] && out="$out | 5h:$(printf '%.0f' "$five")%"; [ -n "$week" ] && out="$out | 7d:$(printf '%.0f' "$week")%"; echo "$out"
